title: Software Engineer in Test (LATAM Only)
description:
Contract:  International contractor — $25/hour

Language:  English (fluent required)

Reports to:  CTO + Engineering Team


About the Role

We’re a healthcare SaaS preparing for go-to-market. Your job is to level up quality and stop regressions before they hit production. You’ll build our automation strategy from scratch and plug it directly into our CI on every pull request.


Tech Stack
  • Frontend:  Next.js, React, Tailwind, shadcn, HeroUI
  • Backend:  Supabase, PostgreSQL
  • Platform:  Web app (desktop-first; mobile web coming soon)
  • CI/CD:  GitHub Actions
  • Compliance:  HIPAA, anonymized test data, auditability


What You’ll Do
  • Own automation strategy + framework (Playwright preferred)
  • Add test gates to PRs via GitHub Actions (keep total pipeline ≤ 12 min)
  • Build reliable UI E2E + component tests for ~10 critical flows
  • Add lightweight performance tests (k6 or similar) and track benchmarks
  • Design test data strategy: synthetic/anonymized, fixtures and env mgmt
  • Keep flake rate ≤ 1–2%; quarantine + deflake quickly
  • Ensure cross-browser coverage (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)
  • Enable in-sprint automation + shift-left reviews
  • Drive quality observability: dashboards, defect triage, audit trails
  • Coach the team (~4 devs, 2 PMs, 2 UX) on testing best practices


What You’ll Bring
  • 3+ years as SDET / Test Automation Engineer
  • Strong coding skills (TypeScript/JavaScript ideal)
  • Hands-on Playwright (or Cypress + willing to migrate)
  • Proven CI-integrated E2E/API test experience (GitHub Actions)
  • Cross-browser + responsive testing experience
  • Solid understanding of React/Next.js + API testing
  • Strong discipline around flakes, determinism, and parallelization
  • Fluent English + great async communication


90-Day Outcomes
  • Playwright suite covering 10 critical flows
  • PR pipeline ≤ 12 minutes with test gates
  • Flake rate ≤ 1–2% with quarantine workflow
  • Cross-browser runs + initial performance baselines


Nice to Have
  • Backend + component testing (Playwright)
  • Accessibility testing (WCAG), visual regression
  • HIPAA/healthcare or anonymized-data experience
  • BrowserStack experience
  • Performance testing: k6/JMeter/Gatling
  • Observability hooks (trace IDs, log scrapers)
  • Supabase/Postgres fixtures + migration testing


How We Work
  • 100% remote (Brazil/US time zones)
  • Close collaboration with CTO + Engineering; partner with Product/UX when needed
  • Pragmatic test pyramid: unit/component/API first; E2E for core journeys; performance/contract tests as gates


Hiring Process
  • Intro chat (30–45 min)
  • Technical deep dive + pairing (60–90 min)
  • System quality/design interview (60 min)
  • Final chat (culture & collaboration)

title: Customer Success Specialist, Life Sciences
description:
JoVE is the world- leading producer and provider of video solutions with the mission to improve scientific research and education. Millions of scientists, educators and students use JoVE for their research, teaching and learning. Our institutional clients comprise over 1,000 universities, colleges, and biopharma companies, including such leaders as Harvard, MIT, Yale and Stanford. As a rapidly growing company, with offices in the USA, UK, Australia, and India servicing clients in over 60 countries, we are seeking talented and ambitious individuals to join our company.


The Role


As a Customer Success Specialist, you will help professors at leading universities in the US integrate JoVE videos into their courses to improve teaching outcomes and student success. You'll play a key role in ensuring users get the most value from their JoVE subscription.



Responsibilities:


  • Conduct daily outreach to Faculty (via calls, emails, and 1:1 demos) to set up JoVE integrations in courses and increase product usage.
  • Increase JoVE adoption by delivering product awareness sessions across existing customer universities and research institutes.
  • Grow engagement and usage by delivering presentations at (1) exhibits and conferences, (2) university seminars and workshops, and (3) onsite customer visits.
  • Strengthen subscription renewal outcomes by ensuring smooth implementation support, and consistent usage of JoVE resources.
  • Influence product decisions by communicating customer feedback to sales, product, and marketing teams.


Requirements:


  • A Master's degree or PhD in Life Science disciplines.
  • 1-3 years of experience in customer facing roles is preferred.
  • Fluent communication skills English.
  • Knowledge of education, market trends, and challenges in assigned content areas i.e. Biology, Chemistry, Medicine, Physics, Engineering, or Psychology.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a passion for remote relationship-building.
  • Experience in networking using cold calling is preferred.


Please share your resume in English.


Why Join JoVE?


  • You can expect compensation packages competitively placed within the local market.
  • You will make a direct impact in accelerating science research and in improving student learning in science education.
  • Opportunity to work with global teams and in an environment that promotes innovation and collaboration.

title: Risk Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain a comprehensive enterprise risk management framework covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks across the organization.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing、scenario analysis、capital adequacy evaluations and other regulatory-mandated reviews.
  • Prepare, validate, and support all regulatory disclosures required of financial institutions and virtual asset service providers (VASPs) , ensuring accuracy and timely submission.

Margin-Account Risk Oversight

  • Lead the governance and oversight of margin-account operations , including:
  • Establishing risk policies for margin lending and virtual asset collateral;
  • Defining and periodically reviewing maximum LTV ratios and haircut methodologies ;
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons, and counterparty exposures;
  • Ensuring adherence to client and institutional exposure limits, capital buffers, and net-worth thresholds.
  • Continuously monitor key risk indicators (KRIs) across business functions, escalating breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board with clear remediation plans.
  • Operate as an independent second-line function , maintaining objectivity from commercial and trading activities while collaborating closely with Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology.
  • Engage with internal/external auditors, regulatory bodies, and governance committees on matters related to risk management, capital adequacy, and prudential standards.
  • Promote a strong risk-aware culture by supporting ongoing training, communication, and enhancements to risk methodologies, models, and documentation.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level experience in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within banks, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and proven capability operating as a second-line or independent control function .
  • Strong command of Central Bank of Brazil risk regulations, prudential rules, capital adequacy requirements, and VASP reporting obligations.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks , stress testing, scenario modeling, and margin-account governance involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field; postgraduate qualifications are strongly preferred.
  • Exceptional analytical skills, strong quantitative capabilities, excellent communication, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.

title: Pessoa Especialista de Desenvolvimento de Sistemas - Full-Stack
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.

Falando da área:

Trabalhar na área de Engenharia da Neoway mantém o colaborador conectado com a inovação, ao constante aprimoramento por melhores metodologias de desenvolvimento e a novas tecnologias para atender os objetivos estratégicos e de negócios da Neoway.

Utilizamos metodologias ágeis por princípio e focamos no ciclo de desenvolvimento de produto para oferecer a melhor experiência aos nossos usuários. O time de Engenharia é responsável por construir, evoluir e sustentar todo o ecossistema que compõem nossa plataforma de Big Data Analytics, chamada Plataforma Neoway.


Acreditamos que um software de qualidade é fácil de usar, funciona corretamente, é de fácil manutenção/sustentação, fácil integração e mantém a integridade para evitar possíveis falhas, fora ou não, do controle de quem o desenvolveu.


Para alcançar este objetivo atuamos em dois pilares distintos para garantir a eficiência do processo de desenvolvimento de software assegurando a qualidade junto a um ambiente saudável na área de Engenharia, no aspecto de boas práticas e cultura de desenvolvimento:


1° - Pessoas é um pilar estratégico para Neoway, atuamos de maneira pró ativa em conjunto com todas as áreas da empresa, garantindo o desenvolvimento de talentos, crescimento profissional e formação do nosso DNA, impulsionando a cultura de times de alta performance (liberdade com responsabilidade).


2° - Técnico (Paved Way), acreditamos que ferramental e a automação ajudam a dimensionar a capacidade de um time, mas nenhuma ferramenta resolverá todos os problemas na produtividade no desenvolvimento ou nas operações. A ideia é ter um conjunto de ferramentas e práticas de “paved way” que são formalmente suportadas por algumas pessoas. Não exigimos a adoção desses “paved way” , mas incentivamos a adoção, garantindo que o desenvolvimento e as operações usando essas tecnologias sejam uma experiência muito melhor do que não usá-las.


Falando do time:

O foco do time é contribuir para a evolução estratégica da Plataforma Neoway, fornecendo às Unidades de Negócio da empresa uma série de sistemas, ferramentas e padrões que apoiam e promovem a autonomia dos demais times de desenvolvimento a acelerar suas entregas e criação de novos produtos.


Missão do cargo:

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software, você terá um papel estratégico na condução de projetos de grande porte e alta complexidade, com impacto direto nos resultados da organização. Sua missão será avaliar, dimensionar e definir parâmetros técnicos que orientem decisões críticas, além de integrar soluções multidisciplinares de forma eficiente.


Você também será responsável por compartilhar conhecimento técnico com o time, sustentando, evoluindo e construindo partes essenciais da nossa plataforma. Atuará garantindo segurança, qualidade do código e solidez arquitetural, buscando constantemente soluções para os desafios do dia a dia. Nosso objetivo é que sua atuação fortaleça o trabalho em equipe, promovendo colaboração, inovação e excelência em engenharia de software.


Como será o seu dia a dia no time:

  • Conceber e implementar soluções técnicas, participando do planejamento, da quebra de tarefas e da execução das demandas.
  • Assegurar a qualidade das entregas, incentivando práticas de Code Review, testes automatizados e desenvolvimento orientado a testes (TDD/BDD).
  • Monitorar e manter serviços sob responsabilidade do time, garantindo sua eficiência, disponibilidade e confiabilidade.
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa nas dinâmicas de trabalho do time, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua de processos e práticas.
  • Participar ativamente das definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade, propondo soluções sustentáveis e alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Desenvolver em linguagens modernas, com foco em backend (Golang, Node.js) e frontend (Vue.js, Angular).
  • Projetar e evoluir soluções distribuídas, baseadas em microsserviços, priorizando resiliência, desempenho e escalabilidade.
  • Aplicar princípios de desenvolvimento seguro, acompanhando atualizações, boas práticas e padrões de segurança de software.


Para assumir estas responsabilidades você precisa ter as seguintes habilidades:

  • Sólida compreensão de arquiteturas escaláveis para grandes volumes de dados (microsserviços, filas, repositórios, etc.).
  • Domínio de conceitos e boas práticas de engenharia de software (ciclo completo: concepção, entrega, sustentação e operação).
  • Experiência avançada em linguagens de backend (Go, Node.js).
  • Experiência avançada em frameworks de frontend (Vue.js, Angular).
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
  • Vivência em infraestrutura em cloud (preferencialmente GCP).
  • Experiência com APIs REST, Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Conhecimento em programação concorrente e escalável.
  • Prática com versionamento de código e pipelines CI/CD.
  • Experiência consistente com Code Review, Feedback e desenvolvimento orientado a testes.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de articular ideias em um ambiente colaborativo.
  • Postura proativa e capacidade de lidar com mudanças como oportunidades de aprendizado.
  • Facilidade em compartilhar conhecimento e apoiar o crescimento do time.
  • Aderência e promoção ativa da nossa cultura e valores.


Alguns diferenciais que estamos de olho. Mas não se preocupe caso não tenha, ajudamos você nessa parte:

  • Conhecimento avançado em Big Data, Data Lake e governança de dados (metadados, boas práticas e requisitos regulatórios).
  • Vivência com infraestrutura como código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Experiência aprofundada no ecossistema de containers (Docker, Kubernetes) com foco em automação, observabilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Conhecimento em serviços de mensageria (Kafka, Pub/Sub, SNS) para sistemas distribuídos e de alta performance.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de armazenamento e análise de dados (BigQuery, ElasticSearch).
  • Experiência em gateway de APIs (Kong).

title: Recruiter
description:
Apesar de ter muitas aplicações não deixe de se aplicar, focamos em talentos específicos e não iremos entrevistar qualquer pessoa para a equipe. Se acredita que tenha 100% de fit conosco, se candidate.


Regime: PJ | Full Remote | Tempo integral


Sobre a ReviewAll

Somos uma consultoria especializada em recrutamento e seleção para o ecossistema de startups e empresas de tecnologia. Atualmente, atendemos mais de 50 clientes, que vão desde early-stage, empresas seed-invested e startups Series A/B/C/D até grandes multinacionais.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gerenciar de 8 a 12 processos seletivos simultâneos nas áreas de tecnologia, produto e negócios. Grande parte das vagas em nível executivo.
  • Conduzir o recrutamento end-to-end.
  • Alinhamento de perfil diretamente com o cliente final e área de pessoas de nossos clientes.
  • Sourcing ativo (LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking)
  • Triagem de currículos e entrevistas técnicas e comportamentais
  • Apresentação de shortlist e negociação de oferta
  • Acompanhamento de onboarding
  • Ser ponto único de contato para stakeholders (tech leads, PMs, diretores e founders), garantindo clareza de expectativas


Requisitos

  • Formação: Nos importamos mais com experiência prática do que formação superior.
  • Experiência: Sólida em executive/tech search, conduzindo de 8 a 12 vagas simultâneas de nível sênior e gerencial, com foco na qualidade da entrega e evitando ser “impressora de currículos”. Foco em recrutamento estratégico e com entrega rápida/efetiva. Nosso SLA de entrega são 5 dias úteis, e nossa taxa de fechamento é entre 3 - 6 indicados.


Perfil

  • Altamente organizado e orientado a resultados
  • Excelente comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ritmo acelerado
  • Resiliência à pressão e postura hands-on
  • Curioso: Nosso perfil é pesquisar sobre vagas, criar estratégias de hunting ground, conseguir ter base para entrevistar candidatos de forma qualificada.
  • Somos uma empresa jovem, com cultura dinâmica, rápida, e anti-burocrática. Se você se identifica com essa linha, será bem-vindo.


Infraestrutura

  • Computador próprio e conexão de internet estável


O que não se alinha com o nosso jeito de trabalhar

  • Dificuldade em lidar com ritmo intenso e alta pressão: Nosso dia a dia é acelerado e está em constante transformação. Quem precisa de supervisão constante, tem dificuldade com pressão ou busca um ambiente previsível pode não se adaptar bem aqui.
  • Ausência de senso de responsabilidade e rejeição à autonomia: Esperamos postura de dono: tomar decisões, assumir riscos e gerar resultados. Quem depende de orientação constante ou busca validação o tempo todo provavelmente não terá espaço. Aqui, o protagonismo é essencial e valorizado com participação nos resultados.
  • Resistência a feedbacks francos e cultura de transparência: Prezamos pela clareza e sinceridade. Feedbacks são recorrentes e parte do nosso desenvolvimento. Isso exige maturidade para aceitar críticas construtivas com abertura e humildade.
  • Apego a horários fixos: Somos uma consultoria em expansão acelerada. Problemas surgem a qualquer momento, e as soluções também. Valorizamos quem entrega com excelência mesmo que isso demande flexibilidade de agenda.


Pacote de remuneração

  • Salário Fixo PJ
  • Variável mensal: potencial médio de R$ 3.000 – 8.000 (com atingimento de meta mensal, é esperado R$4.500 - 6.000), sem teto.

title: AML/CFT Compliance Expert
description:
Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and continuously enhance AML/CFT and sanctions policies in alignment with Brazilian regulatory requirements and global best practices.
  • Act as a primary compliance interface with regulators, including managing inspections, responding to inquiries, and executing remediation plans.
  • Perform risk-based customer due diligence (CDD/KYC/KYB) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) reviews for both individuals and corporate clients.
  • Support ongoing monitoring activities, including transaction surveillance, sanctions screening, and the investigation of alerts or potentially suspicious behaviors.
  • Prepare, review, and submit Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) and other mandatory filings to COAF or relevant regulatory bodies.
  • Track legislative and regulatory developments related to AML/CFT and sanctions, and drive timely updates to internal policies and procedures.
  • Assist in delivering internal training programs to strengthen organizational awareness of AML/CFT and sanctions compliance obligations.
  • Conduct periodic AML/CFT risk assessments to validate control effectiveness and ensure alignment with the company’s enterprise risk management framework.
  • Maintain comprehensive documentation, audit trails, and recordkeeping for all compliance assessments, escalations, investigations, and filings.
  • Support internal and external audits as well as regulatory reviews, ensuring timely and accurate provision of information.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Risk, Operations, and Technology teams to enhance compliance systems, data quality, and operational efficiency.
  • Contribute to the evaluation and oversight of third-party service providers supporting AML/CFT and broader compliance functions.

Requirements

  • Must be legally residing in Brazil.
  • Minimum 7 years of senior-level AML/CFT and sanctions compliance experience within financial services, fintech, or virtual asset service providers (VASPs).
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently as part of the second line of defense , with sound judgment in escalation and decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of COAF, the Central Bank of Brazil, CVM regulations, and FATF recommendations.
  • Hands-on expertise in KYC/KYB processes, transaction monitoring, and suspicious activity reporting.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Economics, or a related field; postgraduate studies or professional certifications (CAMS, ICA, etc.) strongly preferred.
  • Excellent analytical abilities, high ethical standards, and full professional fluency in Portuguese and English.
  • Must satisfy all fit-and-proper requirements, including:
  • No history of bankruptcy or insolvency;
  • An impeccable professional reputation;
  • Strong understanding of the crypto industry, including market dynamics and associated risks;
  • Technical competence aligned with the responsibilities of the role.

description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Python Data Engineer with an AI/ML focus to join our client’s growing data & analytics team in Brazil. This role is ideal for someone who loves building scalable data pipelines, operationalizing machine learning workflows, and partnering closely with data scientists to bring models into production.


You will design, develop, and maintain data infrastructure that powers AI-driven insights across the organization, including data models and pipelines that run through Snowflake . This is a fully remote position working with cross-functional product, engineering, and analytics teams.


Key Responsibilities

  • Build, optimize, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, modern data engineering frameworks, and Snowflake as a central data warehouse.
  • Architect and manage data workflows , ensuring accuracy, scalability, and reliability.
  • Work closely with data scientists to deploy, monitor, and tune machine learning models .
  • Develop feature engineering pipelines , preprocessing workflows, and model-serving APIs.
  • Integrate data from various sources (APIs, databases, cloud storage, streaming platforms).
  • Implement MLOps best practices including versioning, CI/CD for ML, and automated retraining workflows.
  • Optimize data storage, compute usage, and performance within Snowflake and cloud-native tools (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Create and maintain documentation, data catalogs, and operational guides.
  • Monitor data system performance and recommend improvements.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–7+ years of experience as a Data Engineer , Python Engineer , or similar backend/data role.
  • Strong proficiency in Python , including building production-grade data pipelines.
  • Experience with Snowflake —data modeling, Snowpipe, tasks, streams, stored procedures, and performance optimization.
  • Experience with AI/ML workflows : feature engineering, inference pipelines, or deploying models.
  • Proficiency in SQL and relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server).
  • Hands-on experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS , GCP , or Azure ).
  • Experience using data orchestration tools like Airflow , Prefect , or Dagster .
  • Familiarity with MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI , or similar.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, data warehousing, and distributed systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Spark , Databricks , or other big-data processing tools.
  • Experience ingesting and transforming data at scale on Snowflake , including optimization of virtual warehouses.
  • Familiarity with Kafka , Kinesis , or other streaming platforms.
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.).
  • Exposure to deep learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch).
  • Experience working with Brazilian clients or LATAM distributed engineering teams.

title: Farmer / Consultor de Customer Revenue Expansion
description:
Estamos estruturando uma operação de Customer Revenue Expansion orientada por dados, inteligência conversacional e governança de pipeline. Buscamos um perfil Farmer que será responsável por acompanhar, nutrir e acelerar o ciclo de vida dos deals provenientes de Canais Parceiros e do Outbound Inteligente .

Missão do Cargo

Atuar como link estratégico entre parceiros, clientes e equipes internas, garantindo previsibilidade de receita, expansão de contas e sustentação do funil pós-prospecção. O objetivo é maximizar retorno por deal , destravar gargalos e garantir consistência na execução comercial.

Responsabilidades-Chave

• Gerenciar de ponta a ponta o pipeline de deals gerados por parceiros e pelas células de outbound.

• Conduzir rituais de acompanhamento (forecasting, QBRs, health check) para garantir pipeline hygiene e assertividade de conversão.

• Diagnosticar maturidade dos leads, registrando contexto e gaps de compra para orientar a priorização.

• Atuar consultivamente junto aos parceiros para elevar win rate, time-to-close e deal value.

• Implementar frameworks de expansão de receita usando inteligência conversacional (MCI e fluxos autonomizados).

• Criar planos de ação por conta (Account Success Plan) para maximizar LTV e minimizar revenue leakage.

• Alinhar playbooks de execução entre Marketing, Outbound, Parceiros e CX, garantindo consistência nas entregas.

• Monitorar KPIs críticos: deal velocity, conversion rate por etapa, ticket médio por cluster, partner performance, pipeline coverage etc.

• Atuar como PMO comercial para garantir governança, previsibilidade e escalabilidade dos processos.

Requisitos Técnicos

• Vivência em operações comerciais B2B, modelos de canal ou consultoria de expansão de receita.

• Experiência com gestão de pipeline e metodologias como MEDDIC, SPIN, BANT ou similares.

• Capacidade de leitura estratégica de dados, priorização por impacto e tomada de decisão guiada por métricas.

• Familiaridade com automações, inteligência conversacional e ferramentas de Customer Revenue Ops.

• Perfil analítico, consultivo e orientado a entregas com autonomia.

Soft Skills Essenciais

• Comunicação executiva e capacidade de síntese contextual.

• Mindset de colaboração cross-funcional, operando na interseção Marketing–Vendas–Parceiros–CX.

• Disciplina operacional e obsessão por consistência.

• Postura de trusted advisor na relação com parceiros e contas estratégicas.

Modelo de Trabalho

• Regime: PJ

• Local: Remoto

• Remuneração: Fixa + variável baseado em performance e atingimento de metas de receita.

title: Gestor Médico de Desenvolvimento Clínico
description:
Por que trabalhar conosco?


O Butantan é o maior produtor de vacinas e soros da América Latina e o principal fabricante de imunizantes contra a gripe (influenza) do hemisfério Sul. Referência mundial de eficiência e qualidade, também é responsável por grande parte da produção de soros hiperimunes e vacinas oferecidos à população gratuitamente pelo Programa Nacional de Imunizações (PNI), como as vacinas contra hepatite A, hepatite B, HPV, raiva e DTPA.


Aqui no Butantan, valorizamos a diversidade.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, que se traduz no respeito à diversidade de gênero, etnia, pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual (LGBTQIAPN+), crenças e religiões. Buscamos pessoas alinhadas aos nossos valores e que queiram crescer e se desenvolver junto com a instituição.

  • Gestão do desenvolvimento do protocolo de estudo clínico, brochura do investigador ou documento equivalente, termo de consentimento livre e
  • esclarecido, cronograma, orçamento e qualquer outro documento associado ao estudo clínico;
  • Supervisionar e/ou orientar e/ou aprovar (quando necessário ou pertinente) ações e/ou tomadas de decisão em relação ao desenvolvimento clínico

  • Interagir com pesquisadores e cientistas ao interior da instituição e de parceiros externos no desenvolvimento clínicos de produtos;
  • Atuar como Representante do Patrocinador substituto ou como Especialista Médico em relação ao projetos de pesquisa clínicos;
  • Elaborar relatórios, interagir e fornecer informações e/ou explicações aos Comitês de Monitoramento de Segurança de Dados e outros comitês dos
  • estudos de pesquisa clínica;
  • Fazer a gestão do controle orçamentário do estudo clínico por meio de acompanhamento e aprovação dos gastos associados;
  • Contribuir na elaboração e aprovação de documentos e relatórios direcionados ao sistema CEP-CONEP-ANVISA;
  • Representar ao Centro de Ensaios Clínicos e Farmacovigilância em atividades nacionais e internacionais quando solicitado;
  • Desenvolver e/ou contribuir com estudos de interesse do Centro de Ensaios Clínicos e Farmacovigilância tais como: estudos epidemiológicos,
  • bioética e outras áreas relacionadas com pesquisa clínica;
  • Contribuir na elaboração e atuar na execução de programas de treinamento e ensino para colaboradores e estudantes do Centro de Ensaios
  • Clínicos e Farmacovigilância, e para colaboradores do Butantan;
  • Coordenar e atuar na análise de dados oriundos dos estudos clínicos;
  • Atuar, coordenar e /ou gerir as atividades de interface do Centro de Ensaios Clínicos e Farmacovigilância com outras áreas, departamentos,
  • laboratórios e divisões do Butantan;
  • Participar da definição da estratégia clínico-regulatório para o registro de produtos;
  • Atuar nas atividades de interface do Centro de Ensaios Clínicos e Farmacovigilância com autoridades regulatórias e sanitárias em relação ao
  • desenvolvimento clínico de produtos;
  • Criar, implementar e fazer a gestão de planos de resolução de problemas;


Formação Exigida e requisitos imprescindíveis:


  • Superior completo em medicina, com experiência clínica.
  • Pós-graduação sensu-stricto
  • Residência médica e Especialização em área correlata (infectologia, pediatria são preferenciais)
  • Sólida Experiência nas diferentes etapas da Pesquisa Clínica ou Epidemiologia
  • Completo conhecimento das Boas Práticas Clínicas e regulamentos da Pesquisa Clínica
  • Epidemiologia
  • Competência comprovada na gestão de equipes multidisciplinares
  • Inglês Fluente


Nosso pacote de benefícios:


  • Oportunidade de carreira e desenvolvimento;
  • Convênio Médico e convênio odontológico;
  • Plano de Aposentadoria Complementar:
  • TotalPass;
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo;
  • Cartão Ifood Benefícios;
  • Refeitório no local;
  • Vale transporte;
  • Ônibus fretado- Instituto Butantan/Metrô- Metrô/Instituto Butantan;
  • Auxílio creche;
  • Auxílio para filho(a) com deficiência;
  • Auxílio para compra de material escolar;
  • Subsídio de medicamentos;
  • Parcerias na área Educacional e Entretenimento;
  • Acesso aos museus do Instituto Butantan;
  • Day Off de aniversário.


Informações complementares:


  • Período de inscrições: 24/11/2025 até 30/12/2025
  • Quantidade de vaga(s): 01
  • Local de Trabalho: São Paulo - Brasil
  • Horário de trabalho: comercial
  • Modelo de trabalho: 100% Presencial



Como serão as etapas do nosso processo seletivo :


O processo seletivo será composto pelas seguintes etapas:



  • Análise curricular e triagem de candidatos;

Recebemos um volume alto de candidaturas e priorizamos respostas rápidas. Entraremos em contato por e-mail apenas com os candidatos cujo perfil atender às necessidades do projeto.

A mybest é a maior plataforma de recomendações de produtos do Japão, com operação em mais de 10 países, incluindo o Brasil. Nossos conteúdos combinam pesquisa editorial com a experiência de especialistas para ajudar milhões de leitores a comprar com segurança e confiança.

Role Overview:



We have an exciting opportunity for a Payroll Administrator to help with our growing global payroll processes. This role will own the Brazil payroll process but will be hands-on in many other aspects of our payroll operations through data collection, process streamlining, and entity creation. This is a great growth role for anyone wanting to expand their payroll career in a global setting.

Our ideal candidate is a hands-on self-starter who is analytical and methodical, with 4+ years of experience in payroll operations. We also value integrity, team spirit, and strong organizational skills.

This role is fully remote and based in Brazil, however, this role will be dealing with payroll across geographies as we grow.



Responsibilities:



  • Process Brazil payroll for employees in the Deel platform. This will include the monthly regular cycle and all off-cycle payrolls as needed for new hires/terminations.
  • Manage workflow to ensure incoming and outgoing payroll data is processed timely and accurately. Serve as the main point of contact for the Deel payroll team.
  • Remittance of Brazilian employee payroll deposits and monthly FGTS/INSS payroll tax payments.
  • Ability to understand union agreement(s) and serve as a point of contact for employee and/or vendor questions in relation.
  • Knowledge of Brazil payroll tax compliance to ensure the accuracy of system settings and processed transactions.
  • Help to ensure payroll-related tax account registrations are completed as needed.
  • Work closely with our internal accounting department to provide support on payroll-related questions or documentation as needed.
  • Own data collection, entries, and accuracy across multiple systems that impact global payroll operations.
  • Assist employees with inquiries related to payroll matters.
  • Assist with month-end, quarter-end, and year-end payroll processes and related tax reconciliations.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with business partners (People/Benefits/Finance) for process improvements and efficiencies.
  • Create and/or maintain payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
  • Assist in ad-hoc duties when required (ie. audits, payroll backup for other entities, external payment operations, etc.)



Skills/Qualifications Required:



  • Minimum of 2-4 years of payroll processing.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively with team members and other stakeholders.
  • Exposure to a SOX-regulated environment is preferred but not required.
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and proven to have excellent time management skills to deliver results in a fast-paced environment. Strong organizational skills; ability to meet deadlines across multiple tasks.
  • Recent processing experience with Deel or other third-party payroll providers. Exposure to ADP Workforce Now, HiBob, Slack, Jira, and Jibble preferred.
  • Knowledge of Sao Paulo Union agreements and Brazilian labor laws; must be able to read agreements and relay relevant information to team(s) as needed.
  • Strong communication skills, written/verbal, and the ability to interact with employees at all levels. Must be proficient in written and verbal English. Bilingual Portuguese preferred.
  • Strong MS Excel skills required (VLOOKUP’s, Pivot Tables, etc.)



Advantages of joining Turing:


  • Amazing work culture (Super collaborative & supportive work environment; 5 days a week)
  • Awesome colleagues (Surround yourself with top talent from Meta, Google, LinkedIn etc. as well as people with deep startup experience)
  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible working hours

title: ML Data Pipeline Engineer
description:
We're seeking a Data Pipeline Engineer to own and evolve our exercise recognition training data infrastructure. You'll manage the end-to-end pipeline that collects, synchronizes, validates, and prepares IMU sensor and video data for ML model training.

This role combines systems engineering, data quality automation, and hands-on problem-solving in a production environment.


What You’ll Do

Pipeline Operations & Improvement

  • Maintain and enhance our multi-source data collection system: IMU sensors (via mobile app) and synchronized video streams from gym-based cameras.
  • Improve video capture software robustness, particularly handling network interruptions and operational monitoring.
  • Deploy and monitor services in remote Linux environments with appropriate DevOps practices.

Data Quality & Validation

  • Evolve our Python-based QC engine that validates data pre- and post-annotation
  • Implement checks for IMU-video time synchronization, sensor health, and measurement consistency
  • Apply digital signal processing techniques to identify sensor failures, connectivity issues, and measurement irregularities.
  • Develop validation logic comparing annotations against sensor data to ensure temporal alignment.

Analysis & Troubleshooting

  • Perform ad-hoc analysis on ~1,200+ workout tasks to classify failure modes
  • Identify whether issues stem from pipeline bugs, sensor problems, or annotation errors
  • Prioritize engineering work based on data quality impact and coordinate with annotation team on fixes

Tooling and Visualization

  • Maintain and extend our NextJS UI serving annotators, data scientists, and stakeholders
  • Create visualizations (Chart.js) for QC metrics and signal analysis
  • Integrate with LabelStudio annotation interface

What You Bring

Required

  • Strong Python programming skills, particularly for data processing pipelines
  • Experience with time-series data and digital signal processing
  • Comfortable working in Linux environments and deploying/monitoring remote services
  • Ability to debug complex multi-component systems (sensors, video, networks, sync)
  • Data quality mindset: designing validation rules, tracking metrics, investigating anomalies
  • SQL/database experience for managing pipeline metadata

Highly Valued

  • Video processing experience (RTSP streams, encoding, OCR)
  • Working with sensor/IoT data and handling connectivity challenges
  • NextJS or modern web frameworks for data tooling
  • DevOps practices: containerization, monitoring, logging, alerting
  • Experience with annotation pipelines and ML training data workflows
  • Background in biomechanics, sports science, or wearable sensors

Tech Stack

  • Languages: Python (primary), JavaScript/TypeScript (NextJS UI)
  • Data: IMU sensor streams, video (RTSP), time-series analysis, DSP
  • Tools: LabelStudio, Chart.js, Linux/bash, OCR libraries
  • Infrastructure: Remote deployment, monitoring systems

You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Enjoy detective work: diagnosing why data doesn't match expectations
  • Balance pragmatism with quality: shipping improvements while maintaining reliability
  • Communicate well across technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Can work autonomously in a small, mission-driven team

title: Engenheiro de software sênior
description:
A Applause é uma das startups que mais crescem no Brasil. Somos uma plataforma gestão de campanhas de incentivo com o objetivo de incentivar e gamificar a jornada de profissionais de vendas e outras áreas, onde usuários que cumprem metas e missões ganham pontos que podem ser trocados por diversas experiências dentro da nossa plataforma, como hotéis, restaurantes, games e entretenimento.


Atualmente, contamos com cerca de 400 mil usuários e estamos em um ritmo acelerado de crescimento, com a ambição de escalar a plataforma para 10 milhões de usuários nos próximos anos.


A área de Engenharia de Software é fundamental para essa evolução. Nosso foco é sustentar o crescimento sólido, garantindo performance, segurança e estabilidade. Adotamos práticas modernas de engenharia, arquitetura cloud-native e sistemas distribuídos (microsserviços, containers, Kubernetes, Big Data & AI) , com especialização em processamento intensivo de dados para suportar nossa ambiciosa meta de escala.


Sua missão principal como Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior será:

  • Arquitetar e executar a nossa visão de escala em colaboração com CPO e CTO. 
  • Desenvolver novas features e evoluir as existentes, garantindo soluções altamente escaláveis e eficientes, essenciais para suportar o crescimento para 10 milhões de usuários.
  • Participar ativamente de decisões de arquitetura distribuída de sistemas , microserviços e design voltado a alto volume e intensidade de dados, propondo soluções e colaborando na evolução da nossa plataforma.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time em backend, promovendo a excelência técnica e padrões de qualidade.
  • Desenvolver o backend da plataforma, focando em robustez, escala, segurança e performance.
  • Trabalhar em integrações complexas com terceiros, como marketplaces e provedores de prêmios (i.e. Gift Cards).
  • Alta colaboração com o time de tecnologia, clientes e demais áreas, transformando problemas complexos em soluções de alta eficiência e baixo impacto operacional.


Experiência: 

  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos como desenvolvedor, sendo no mínimo 4 anos em ambientes de alto crescimento, startups ou equivalente.
  • Experiência comprovada em arquiteturas escaláveis, resilientes e baseadas em microserviços e sistemas distribuídos.


Competências técnicas/ Hard Skills:

  • Experiência avançada em Node.js, NextJS, MongoDB, SQL e integrações de APIs de terceiros.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em orquestração de containers, especialmente com Kubernetes.
  • Experiência sólida com serviços AWS (Amazon Web Services) para infraestrutura, escalabilidade e Big Data (ex: EC2, Lambda, Kafka, S3, Databricks, EMR, Kinesis, RDS/DynamoDB).
  • Experiência com Big Data e construção de data pipelines ou soluções de processamento de dados em larga escala.
  • Visão e experiência na construção de aplicações escaláveis para múltiplos milhões de usuários.


Competências Comportamentais/ Soft Skills:

  • Pensamento flexível e colaborativo.
  • Pró-atividade e autorresponsabilidade.
  • Foco no usuário e na entrega de valor.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com TypeScript e testes automatizados.
  • Desejável experiência ou interesse em integrar serviços de Inteligência Artificial/Machine Learning (AI/ML) para aprimoramento de predições e escala da plataforma.


Condições de trabalho:

Whether you're managing projects, leading accounts, or building internal capabilities, your work will shape the growth trajectory of companies at the forefront of healthcare transformation. 


We value curiosity, accountability, and execution. If you thrive in fast-paced settings, enjoy solving complex problems, and want to accelerate your career alongside a team that’s redefining how healthcare companies go to market, this is the place to do it. 


SalesSparx by the Numbers

  • 10K+ hours of sales best practice research 
  • $1B+ client bookings 
  • SVS Process used to manage 50K+ sales opportunities per year 
  • 9.9/10 Client Net Promoter Score 
  • Published Light Your Sales FUSE in 2023, the only Healthcare-focused Sales Acceleration Guide in the industry 


Opportunity  


The Enablement Process & Curriculum Operations Manager leads the operational backbone behind SalesSparx’s internal training systems, documentation structure, and methodology governance. 


This professional maintains the single source of truth for internal processes, training curricula, templates, and onboarding structures. They ensure consultants follow the right learning paths, have access to accurate materials, and that our methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) remain organized, structured, and current. 


This is a hands-on, detail-oriented role focused on execution, documentation discipline, and content operations, in additional to management responsibilities. In the short term this person will develop the content to support our operational process and over time will build up its own team. 


What You’ll Do  

Process Documentation & Knowledge Extraction  

  • Interview team members, shadow workflows, and extract tribal knowledge. 
  • Translate informal processes into clear documentation, SOPs, and structured modules. 
  • Maintain an organized, version-controlled process repository. 
  • Ensure internal methodologies (SVS, FUSE GTM, consulting workflows) are accurately documented and regularly updated. 

Template Governance & Content Maintenance  

  • Own the lifecycle and organization of: SVS materials, Go-to-Market assets and Internal consulting templates 
  • Audit and update templates on a defined cadence. 
  • Enforce consistency, version control, and internal standards for all materials. 
  • Maintain a centralized template library that is easy for consultants to access and navigate. 

Training Curriculum & LMS Development  

  • Convert existing training materials into structured LMS modules. 
  • Build quizzes, assessments, practice exercises, and progress tracking workflows. 
  • Maintain curriculum versions and ensure training content remains aligned to current methodology. 
  • Support training execution logistics (materials prep, assignments, communications). 

Onboarding Coordination  

  • Build a structured onboarding flow for new consultants. 
  • Ensure every new hire follows the correct learning path and completes required modules. 
  • Track onboarding progress and report on readiness or gaps. 
  • Provide execution support to the team members leading training sessions. 

Learning Path Compliance & Monitoring  

  • Track consultant participation in learning paths. 
  • Follow up on incomplete modules and escalate when needed. 
  • Maintain dashboards or tracking sheets for enablement completion. 
  • Ensure training compliance is consistently monitored and documented. 

Who We’re Looking For  


Education  

  • Bachelor’s degree in Administration, Business, Education, Sales, Communications, or related fields. 
  • Master’s degree preferred (Education, Instructional Design, Adult Learning, Curriculum & Instruction, or similar). 


Experience  

  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.
  • Experience on working in a Management Consulting firm is required
  • 5+ years in roles such as: Training Coordinator, Instructional Design Specialist, Enablement Coordinator, Curriculum Development Assistant, Knowledge Management Specialist, or Process Documentation/PMO Support. 
  • Experience on training Management Consultants is required.  
  • Experience building training materials, documenting processes, and maintaining structured content repositories. 
  • Familiarity with LMS platforms, learning paths, assessments, and completion tracking. 
  • Experience in process-driven, documentation-heavy environments. 
  • No prior healthcare experience required. 


Skills  

  • Fluent written and spoken English. 
  • Capable to work on EST hours. 
  • Strong organizational discipline in a fully remote environment. 
  • Ability to extract insights from SMEs and convert them into structured content. 
  • Comfort building onboarding flows, training assets, and learning materials. 
  • Proficiency with: 
  • Documentation tools (SharePoint, Google Drive, etc.) 
  • LMS or course-authoring tools 
  • Project management tools (Asana) 
  • Basic design/editing platforms (Canva, PowerPoint) 
  • Strong attention to detail, consistency, and version control. 
  • Ability to handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion. 

Compensation

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sr.
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.

A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


Seu papel:


Como Engenheiro(a) de Dados, suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Desenvolvimento de Pipelines Escaláveis: Criar e manter processos de ingestão de dados altamente eficientes (Batch, Streaming, CDC) para grandes volumes, garantindo a integridade, conformidade e resiliência dos dados.
  • Modelagem e Otimização: Projetar, implementar e otimizar estruturas de dados no Data Lake/Lakehouse, orientadas à governança e que atendam às necessidades estratégicas dos times de Analytics e Negócios.
  • Qualidade e Governança: Desenvolver e manter processos de tratamento, aplicando frameworks avançados de validação (como DQX) e garantindo a qualidade e acessibilidade dos dados.
  • Monitoramento e Suporte: Implementar ferramentas e práticas de monitoramento contínuo para garantir a disponibilidade, desempenho e conformidade do Data Lake, atuando de forma proativa na resolução de problemas.
  • Liderança Técnica em Governança: Liderar a implantação e utilização do Catálogo Unity no Databricks para documentar e organizar ativos, assegurando o cumprimento das políticas de governança de dados.


O que esperamos de você:

Buscamos um(a) profissional com as seguintes experiências e conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Arquitetura de Dados: Conhecimento profundo e experiência prática na aplicação de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e Lakehouse.
  • Linguagens e Frameworks: Proficiência em Python (scripts, automações, ETL/ELT, PySpark, Pandas) e SQL avançado (tuning de queries, modelagem, window functions).
  • Nuvem Azure: Experiência avançada com o ecossistema Azure, incluindo Data Factory, Databricks e Data Lake .
  • Engenharia Essencial: Sólida experiência em arquiteturas distribuídas e padrões de ingestão de dados (Batch, Streaming, CDC).
  • Governança de Dados e DataOps: Experiência em catalogação, linhagem, qualidade e aplicação dos princípios de DataOps e DMBoK .
  • DevOps/MLOps: Experiência na criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD com ferramentas como Github .
  • Segurança da Informação: Conhecimento e aplicação da camada de segurança (criptografia, LGPD e mascaramento de dados).


Habilidades Comportamentais:

  • Comunicação Eficaz, Empatia e Colaboração (Interação com Squads).
  • Senso de Urgência e Proatividade no contexto técnico.
  • Capacidade de Resolução de Problemas complexos, através de visão analítica e raciocínio lógico.
  • Flexibilidade e Resiliência em cenários de alta complexidade.
  • Paixão pela Qualidade e Visão Holística do negócio.




Diferenciais:

Estes itens não são mandatórios, mas serão considerados um bônus para a posição Sênior:

  • Experiência em Liderança Técnica e/ou Arquitetura de Projetos .
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em SQL Server (SSMS, SSIS e SSAS) e ferramentas de visualização como Power BI .
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em análise funcional, modelagem de dados e elaboração de documentação técnica de soluções.
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de três camadas, ambiente as a service, barramento (BUS) e orquestração.
  • Experiência com API’s para envio e recepção de informações e ferramentas como Excel no contexto de dados.


Nosso processo seletivo e compromisso com a diversidade

Na #Juntos, valorizamos a jornada de aprendizagem mútua: queremos descobrir, juntos, o potencial de cada pessoa em todas as etapas do processo. Nosso objetivo é criar uma experiência transparente, justa e eficiente, alinhada aos nossos valores e à nossa cultura de protagonismo e impacto.

Acreditamos que um time diverso e autêntico é essencial para gerar soluções verdadeiramente inovadoras. Aqui, você será encorajado a ser você mesmo(a), trazendo suas singularidades para somar ao coletivo. Promovemos inclusão de forma concreta, com ações afirmativas que buscam ampliar vozes de diferentes origens e perspectivas.


Se você busca um ambiente onde pode ser quem é, aprender com liberdade e contribuir com impacto real, seu lugar pode ser aqui. Vem construir com a gente o maior ecossistema da construção civil!

title: Remote Data Entry Coordinator (Food Products)
description:
Data Entry Assistant — Pilot R&D (Remote, Full-Time)


This role requires English proficiency , both written and spoken.


The Vision

At Pilot R&D , ingredients are the foundation of everything we do. As a culinary innovation and product development company, we help food and beverage brands bring their ideas to life — from cookies to kombucha. Behind every successful recipe is accurate, reliable data.


Accurate ingredient data powers all our work — and you’ll play a key role in keeping our internal database (The Walk-In) clean, organized, and reliable as we work across dozens of fast-moving projects.


Who We’re Looking For

We’re seeking a detail-driven, tech-savvy, and proactive person who enjoys structured work, organizing information, and solving small data puzzles.

If you love accuracy, can spot inconsistencies quickly, and enjoy turning messy inputs into clean, precise data — this role will fit you perfectly.

You’ll support our Ingredient Sourcing team by reviewing supplier emails, extracting critical details (pricing, MOQs, certifications, etc.), and entering them into our system with accuracy and consistency.


Why You Should Join Us

  • Be part of a fast-moving, innovative food and beverage development company working with top industry brands.
  • Join a small, collaborative team that values communication, curiosity, and growth.
  • Play a key role in shaping a new, foundational position within the company — you’ll help define what great data accuracy looks like for Pilot R&D.
  • Work remotely and independently , while still being connected daily through Slack and team check-ins.


Role Responsibilities

  • Enter all ingredient information into The Walk-In , our internal platform.
  • Upload supporting documents such as specification sheets, nutritional facts, GRAS and non-GMO statements, and certifications.
  • Input supplier data: pricing tiers, minimum order quantities, lead times, and FOB locations.
  • Set up new supplier profiles and maintain contact information.
  • Identify missing information and coordinate with the Sourcing Manager and Coordinator to complete data entries.
  • Perform regular data cleanup and validation to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Collaborate closely with the sourcing team to ensure smooth data flow and transparency.


Skills & Experience

Must Have:

  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong written and reading English skills.
  • Reliable communication and responsiveness during 9 AM–5 PM PST business hours.
  • Comfortable interpreting information from emails and attachments
  • Proficient in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office .
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable following structured processes.
  • Tech-comfortable and willing to learn internal tools quickly.


Nice to Have:

  • Experience with Excel/Google Sheets or database tools.
  • Prior exposure to purchasing, procurement, or ingredient sourcing .
  • Background in food science, nutrition, chemistry, biology, or lab work.
  • Basic knowledge of coding or systems integration.
  • Familiarity with metric units .


Our Values

At Pilot R&D, our work blends innovation and science with a spirit of integrity and collaboration . We value clear communication, honest feedback, and building relationships — with our partners, clients, and team members. We believe in working hard, staying curious, and enjoying the process — after all, we’re making food for a living.


Compensation & Employment Type

Type: Independent contractor, Full-time (40 hours/week)


Location: Remote (LATAM preferred)

Hours: 9 AM – 5 PM PST

Compensation: Starting at $1,000 USD/month (depending on experience)

Timeline: Hiring within 30–90 days


Application Process

Please email the following to Maria+ :

Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.DataEntry.pdf)

Cover Letter , including:

a) What interests you about working with Pilot R&D and this data-focused role

b) Specific experiences that show your attention to detail, organization, and reliability

c) How you stay focused and accurate when doing repetitive or technical work

d) What you enjoy doing outside of work


Well-structured, thoughtful applications will stand out. If you have any questions about the role or responsibilities, feel free to include them in your message.

title: Lead Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


A Dexian incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Você irá atuar em um projeto global do nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do setor de óleo e gás , assumindo um papel técnico-estratégico dedicado ao Azure DevOps (ADO) e às plataformas de dados.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Trabalhar com estruturas de dados de média a alta complexidade em ambiente corporativo.
  • Atuar de forma hands-on com SQL para manipulação e análise de dados.

  • Implementar lógica e análises utilizando DAX.
  • Modelar dados (normalização, desnormalização e star schema).
  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos DBT, incluindo criação de testes de dados.
  • Atuar com soluções em Azure para armazenamento, integração e processamento de dados.
  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes Azure DevOps: acessos, permissões, configurações de projeto, repositórios e integrações.
  • Colaborar com stakeholders internos e externos para avaliar automações, integrações e fluxos customizados dentro do Azure DevOps.
  • Oferecer direcionamento técnico sobre uso avançado da plataforma Azure DevOps, incluindo escalabilidade e integrações com GitHub, ServiceNow e serviços Azure.
  • Criar e manter automações utilizando Power Platform (principalmente Power Automate).
  • Comunicar conceitos técnicos complexos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos em inglês.


O que você precisa ter

  • Forte experiência em administração de Azure DevOps (ADO) e pipelines.
  • Experiência sólida com Power Platform, principalmente Power Automate.
  • SQL avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência com ADF, Data Pipelines e orquestração de dados.
  • Conhecimento em DBT e DAX.
  • Conhecimentos de Azure Infrastructure.
  • Experiência em liderança técnica.
  • Perfil com forte senso de ownership e visão de dono da solução.
  • Inglês avançado (mandatório)



Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Será um destaque seu perfil com:

Experiência com Python ou PowerQuery/Power BI.

Certificações relevantes:

  • DP-203 – Azure Data Engineer Associate
  • PL-500 – Power Platform Developer Associate

Experiência em ambientes corporativos com estruturas de dados complexas.

Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção a detalhes.

  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI and automation tools and assess their applicability in client use cases.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal teams to scope, deliver, and maintain agentic and automation solutions aligned with business goals.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of hands-on experience in AI/ML development, including training and deploying models in production.

  • Experience working with AI tools like Langchain, OpenAI, or Stable Diffusion .
  • Practical experience with automation platforms and AI agent builders (as listed above).
  • Deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and NLP concepts.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with distributed computing frameworks such as Spark or Ray .
  • Background in AI agency workflows and client-facing solution delivery.


Work Environment & Benefits


  • Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
  • Flexible work environment: Remote-first .
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture with a commitment to personal and professional growth.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of AI innovation across industries and verticals.

title: Analista de segurança
description:
Required Skills and Experience:

The ideal candidate will bring foundational experience in security operations with a demonstrated ability to investigate and respond to security events. A strong focus on Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is essential, including the ability to analyze data movement, enforce classification standards, and coordinate remediation efforts. Candidates should be comfortable working in dynamic environments, applying core SOC concepts while developing deeper expertise in protecting sensitive data.


  • Experience in cybersecurity or information technology within a SOC or incident response role.
  • Hands-on experience working with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) technologies and processes.
  • Familiarity with common data classification categories (e.g., PII, PCI, PHI) and their security and compliance implications.
  • Experience using Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) systems for monitoring, triage, and analysis.
  • Exposure to endpoint protection solutions, including antivirus, EDR, or other detection and response technologies.
  • Experience triaging security incidents in cloud-native and SaaS environments .
  • Working knowledge of TCP/IP protocols and OSI Layers 1–4.
  • Ability to analyze event logs and alerts, correlate them with DLP activity, and determine the appropriate remediation.
  • Basic knowledge of adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), Cyber Kill Chain, and MITRE ATT&CK framework.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills for documenting incidents and working with stakeholders during investigations.
  • Ability to maintain integrity, professionalism, and discretion when handling sensitive data.
  • Highly organized, efficient, and capable of managing multiple incidents or tasks with minimal supervision.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience tuning or refining DLP policies and rules to improve accuracy and reduce false positives.
  • Familiarity with cloud security controls and data governance concepts (e.g., encryption, access control, retention).
  • Exposure to cybersecurity threat hunting techniques and proactive analysis methods.
  • Basic scripting or automation knowledge (e.g., Python, PowerShell, or similar) to support repetitive triage tasks.


Education/Certifications/Training Required:

  • Basic industry certification, such as CompTIA Security+, CySA+, or GIAC.
  • Associates' or Bachelors’ Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Security Assurance, or equivalent experience.

title: ADP Tester
description:
ADP Tester – Workday to ADP Payroll Transformation

Title: ADP Tester (5–7 Years)

Location: Brazil 100% Remote

Type: Contract

Client: Kyndryl

Overview

We are seeking an experienced ADP Tester to support a large-scale Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation program. The consultant will be responsible for validating end-to-end payroll processing across Workday and ADP (GlobalView / Workforce Now / Celergo), ensuring data accuracy, compliance with payroll rules, and a smooth transition to the new payroll landscape. This role requires strong hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions, deep understanding of gross-to-net calculations, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams in HR, Payroll, and IT.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, design, and execute test cases for Workday-to-ADP payroll integrations, including end-to-end payroll cycles.
  • Validate payroll processing results, including earnings, deductions, taxes, and gross-to-net calculations across ADP platforms.
  • Review and validate data mapping and transformations between Workday and ADP (GlobalView, Workforce Now, or Celergo).
  • Test inbound and outbound interface files between Workday and ADP, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to defined formats.
  • Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) for payroll-related processes.
  • Log, track, and document defects using the client’s defect management tools, working with technical and functional teams to drive timely resolution.
  • Support parallel payroll testing cycles by comparing legacy and new payroll results, identifying and analyzing variances.
  • Collaborate closely with Workday configuration teams, ADP SMEs, payroll operations, and project managers to clarify requirements, test scenarios, and acceptance criteria.
  • Develop and maintain test documentation, including test plans, scripts, scenarios, and status reports.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes, standards, and templates for payroll transformation projects.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 5–7 years of hands-on experience testing ADP payroll solutions.
  • Practical experience with one or more of the following: ADP GlobalView, ADP Celergo, and/or ADP Workforce Now.
  • Strong knowledge of payroll rules, calculations, and end-to-end gross-to-net processing (earnings, deductions, benefits, taxes).
  • Experience testing payroll integrations, including validation of inbound and outbound interface files.
  • Ability to design and execute test cases, analyze results, and document defects in a structured way.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with high attention to detail and data accuracy.
  • Experience working in cross-functional, global environments with HR, Payroll, and IT stakeholders.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Nice to Have / Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of Workday payroll configuration and Workday payroll interface (WPI) or similar Workday outbound interfaces.
  • Experience with large-scale payroll transformation or migration projects.
  • Prior experience working with global payroll across multiple countries and legal entities.
  • Familiarity with Agile delivery methodologies and working within structured project frameworks.

Engagement Details

This is a contract position supporting Kyndryl on a Workday-to-ADP payroll transformation initiative. Candidates may be based in the US, Brazil, or India and must be comfortable collaborating with distributed, multicultural teams located in multiple time zones.

title: Staff Product Engineer (Software)
description:
Staff Product Engineer (Software)

Our Stack

  • TypeScript (React) — frontend
  • Postgres (Supabase)
  • PostHog for product analytics
  • AWS
  • GitHub


What You’ll Do1. Build

title: QA Engineer (Salesforce)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $3,000 - $4,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Quality Engineer to join their high-performing engineering organization as they continue to innovate and scale their global product suite. As a leader in tech scouting and innovation management software, our partner empowers the world's top companies and research institutions to accelerate discovery, collaboration, and operational excellence.


As an Al-First Quality Engineer, you will go beyond writing and executing test cases. You will harness the power of Al to predict defects, optimize test coverage, and accelerate delivery. ￮ Manage and mitigate technical and testing risk across projects, ensuring the right testing scope and sequencing to achieve team objectives and enable faster, safer releases.

￮ Leverage predictive analytics to identify defect-prone areas and prioritize risk-based testing.

  • Collaborate with developers, architects, and product managers to integrate Al-powered quality checks into CI/CD pipelines and unblock Al-powered workflows
  • Validate AI/ML based functionality for accuracy and reliability as part of the release process.


What We're Looking For:

  • 3+ years of proven experience in software quality engineering, test automation, or SDET roles.

￮ Experience across the breadth of application testing types: end-to-end testing, load and volume performance testing, API testing, etc.

  • Proven experience with testing against the Salesforce Platform

￮ Understanding of platform and change management concepts: sandboxes, templates, packages, and changesets. Experience with Salesforce Second-Generation Managed Packages is strongly desired.

￮ Knowledge of platform limits and constraints to inform data volume testing

￮ Experience administering Salesforce and/or strong Salesforce configuration skills

  • Strong programming skills, with familiarity across several languages (C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, SQL, etc.).
  • Understanding of Al/ML concepts and hands-on experience using Al-enabled development and testing tools
  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright preferred) and their intersection with Al tools (such as Playwright MCP Server)
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, DevOps practices, and cloud-native environments.
  • Self-driven work style, with initiative to exploring, learning, and applying novel concepts and techniques
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with a mindset for experimentation and continuous improvement.
  • Experience in analyzing data sets for defect prediction, anomaly detection, or performing root cause analysis.


Work Schedule: You MUST be able to work during core U.S. Time Zone working hours.  


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a growing company at the forefront of Salesforce-driven enterprise solutions.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Scheduling Optimization Engineer
description:
About You

You are a data-driven professional passionate about solving complex scheduling and resource allocation challenges. You thrive on applying advanced optimization techniques to real-world problems, balancing mathematical rigor with practical feasibility. With strong analytical and modeling skills, you design solutions that improve efficiency, reduce costs, and ensure compliance with operational and regulatory requirements.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Advanced knowledge of optimization modeling (integer programming, constraint programming, heuristics/metaheuristics).
  • Proven experience developing and maintaining large-scale scheduling models in applied environments.
  • Ability to incorporate operational rules, contractual agreements, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Hands-on experience with optimization solvers (e.g., Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Julia, or C++.
  • Strong understanding of data analysis for planning based on event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destination planning.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain advanced optimization models to solve large-scale scheduling problems.
  • Build models that consider event calendars, service times, passenger volumes, and destinations using available data.
  • Integrate operational rules, contractual obligations, regulatory requirements, and business constraints into model formulations.
  • Apply optimization solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools) to generate feasible, efficient schedules.
  • Collaborate with operations, planning, and technology teams to align outputs with real-world needs.
  • Analyze results to identify cost savings, efficiency improvements, and compliance risks.
  • Continuously refine models to adapt to changes in resource availability, demand patterns, and operational constraints.

title: Salesforce Administrator (Part-Time)
description:
We are looking for a part-time, remote Salesforce Administrator with 3-5 years of Salesforce administration experience to join our U.S. client's team. You will work 10 to 15 hours per week supporting the ongoing development, configuration, and management of Salesforce across the Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Customer Service organizations. The ideal candidate will have strong technical expertise, a keen analytical mind, and the ability to drive business outcomes through platform optimization and insightful data analysis.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Partner with cross-organizational teams to gather requirements and deliver scalable solutions
  • Administer and maintain the Salesforce environment, ensuring data integrity, system stability, and optimal performance
  • Configure, customize, and maintain Salesforce objects, fields, workflows, validation rules, page layouts, and other settings to support business processes
  • Develop and maintain Salesforce Flows, reports, and dashboards to provide actionable insights and improve user productivity
  • Design and implement new features or system enhancements
  • Manage integrations between Salesforce and third-party platforms, ensuring data consistency and seamless functionality
  • Conduct testing, troubleshooting, and documentation for new configurations, automation, and system updates
  • Monitor and manage user accounts, roles, permissions, and security settings in accordance with company policies
  • Stay current with Salesforce releases, features, and best practices; recommend improvements and lead adoption of new capabilities
  • Provide user support, training, and documentation for more effective system usage


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 3-5 years of experience as a Salesforce Administrator in enterprise, B2B environments
  • Proficiency in Salesforce setup and configuration
  • Solid understanding of CRM principles and Salesforce best practices
  • Experience in Sales Cloud and Salesforce Flow development, reporting, and dashboard creation
  • Experience with integration tools and third-party platforms
  • Ability to review, design, and test new features and customizations independently
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Commitment to continuous learning as well as staying current with platform updates
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, business, or a related field
  • Certification as a Salesforce Administrator or Sales Cloud Consultant


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
